orders.title: My orders
orders.error: We couldn't load your orders. Please try again.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Use the phone number you gave with your order. We'll send you a code by SMS.
login.codeSent: We've sent a code by SMS to {phone}.
login.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {time}.

errors.invalidPhone: Check the phone number: it should be a mobile number from the country you chose.
errors.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Check the SMS and try again.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.wait: Too many attempts for this number. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.offline: There's no connection. Check it and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

report.title: Report an incident
report.sending: Sending… this may take a moment.

errors.descriptionTooLong: The description is too long. Use at most {max} characters.
errors.orderNotFound: We could not find this order.
errors.generic: We could not send the report. Try again in a moment.

evidence.title: Photos and videos
evidence.hint: Up to {maxFiles} files. Photos up to {imageMb} MB, videos up to {videoMb} MB.
evidence.suggestPhoto: A photo of the problem helps us solve it faster.

rejected.type: {name} was not added. Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, HEIF) and videos (MP4, MOV) can be attached.
rejected.size: {name} was not added because it is too big. Photos can be up to {imageMb} MB and videos up to {videoMb} MB.
rejected.tooMany: {name} was not added. You can attach up to {maxFiles} files.

incident.title: Incident
incident.error: We couldn't load your incident. Please try again.

notFound.title: We can't find this incident
notFound.description: It may not exist or it may belong to another account.

next.open: We've received your report. Next, we'll let the driver know so they can check what happened.
next.notified: The driver knows about your incident. Next, we'll set up a call with you, the driver and our support team.
next.in_mediation: We're setting up a call with you, the driver and our support team. We'll send you an SMS when it's ready.
next.in_mediation_call: Your call is ready. Join it to sort out the incident with the driver and our support team.
next.resolved: Your incident is resolved. There's nothing else you need to do.
next.escalated: We've passed your incident to a specialist team. They'll contact you to sort it out.

status.in_mediation: We started setting up a call to sort it out
status.escalated: We passed the incident to a specialist team

events.evidence_uploaded: You added a photo or video
events.assigned: A support agent is reviewing your incident

incidentsList.title: My incidents
incidentsList.subtitle: Check the status of your recent incidents.
incidentsList.empty: You don't have any recorded incidents yet. You can report a problem from your orders.

call.title: Mediation call
call.intro: Join the call to sort out your incident with support and the driver.

participants.driver: The driver of your order, by phone

call.microphoneIntro: When you tap “Join the call”, your browser will ask to use your microphone. Allow it so the others can hear you. We only use it during this call.
call.evidenceNote: The agent can see your photos and video during the call.

microphoneHelp.title: Allow the microphone
microphoneHelp.intro: The call needs your microphone, but your browser has blocked it. Allow it with these steps and try again.
microphoneHelp.chromeStep1: Tap the icon to the left of the web address.

errors.notAvailable: This call isn't available. The mediation may not have started yet, or it has already ended.
errors.noConnection: There's no connection. Check it and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: The call session has expired. Join again to continue.
errors.microphoneUnavailable: We couldn't find a microphone, or another app is using it. Check it and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

update.description: Reload to get the latest version of the app.
